text_block_list.text: Early one day on a dimly lit morning…

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelousness starts now☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Marve-chin?! If you're around here,
say "Marvelous!". 
Jeez, where could she have gone? Ooh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san!
You're supposed to be looking for 
Marve-chin too! She's been missing since 
morning! Are you not worried about her?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Not particularly.
She's probably just busy right 
now. And quit yelling at me.
I don't want people 
to associate me with you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But Marve-chin is super super curious!
What if 
she managed to get to space or
something…?! 
Waah! Marve-chin!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm tired of this. I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Are those cherry blossom petals? 
Isn't it way too early for that?
Hehe… Ahaha! Yup, that's perfect!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Spinny spinny! Poof!
We need more and more! 
Bloom in marvelousness☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Spinny spinny♪ Poof♪ Hmm?
Is that Brian-chan?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I have no idea what you two are doing.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I had a feeling that marvelousness was 
beginning,
but I didn't know where☆ But it turns 
out that Laurel found it first★
Marvelousness truly has begun!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
I found a cherry blossom tree blooming 
early. Look,
it's over there. It seems like 
that's what Marve-chin was looking for
too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Aah, so the cherry blossoms I saw were 
from here.
I guess spring really is coming.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yup, and another form of spring is 
coming too! The spring of Sakura Laurel!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Your spring, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If the cherry blossoms are beginning to 
bloom, then as a Sakura I have to bloom 
as well. I'll bloom brighter than anyone 
else. Look forward to it, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa☆ I feel like something marvelous is
gonna happen★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heeey!! You guys are big meanies! 
Having fun without me…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
More importantly! I'm the one who's 
supposed to be having a marvelous time with
Brian!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well why don't we head back to the 
academy?
It's been a while since we've all hung 
out, so why don't we continue this
conversation on the track? ♪
At the same time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh ho!
What a coincidence… Or should I say 
that this was highly probable?
That family 
restaurant is your favorite after all, so 
perhaps it was an inevitability.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, don't make that face. We're friends,
are we not? 
Why don't we gather around the table and 
eat together harmoniously like we always
do?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Parfait parfait parfaifaifait♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh ho? The coincidences continue to occur,
huh? 
You seem quite pleased, Pocke-kun.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, if it isn't Tachyon and Cafe!
Check this parfait out! 
It's got so many things on it, all topped 
off by cherries. What do you guys think?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I don't know what to say…

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it perfect?!
Parfaits really are the best! 
You two should order one too so we can eat
some together♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Haa… I was planning on getting coffee here and enjoying my afternoon… but I seem to have been swept up by two annoying individuals…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I don't need to explain why Tachyon-san is a problem, but Pocke-san… aside from her crudeness, she's quite intimidating…

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Aaah!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What's with you?
Why're you yelling so loudly? 
All I did was take the cherry that you
left. You were just staring at them,
so it's not my fault.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I left it for a reason!!
That was the best part!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph,
my apologies. But don't you think you're 
worrying too much over some cherries?
They've 
already been turned into fructose inside of
my body after all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by some cherries?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'm tired of you. Shut up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, how frightening. Was me taking those 
cherries the trigger for this sudden
change?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you what happens when 
you push my buttons. Meet me outside.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Haa, I'll just get her a new—
Alright, that's enough, you two.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fuji-san!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for being late,
Pocke. I was busy dealing 
with some issues at the dormitories.
Have you 
been waiting long? Sorry if you have.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it,
I get that you're busy! Plus,
I was just having a nice chat with my two 
classmates! Isn't that right,
Tachyon♪ Cafe♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Such extreme shifts in personality…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well,
I'm glad to see you're all getting along… 
but this seems hard on Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No, not particularly… if those two had gotten
violent, I 
would've borrowed my friend's power to take
care of them both.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Wait, i-is that… a… gh-ghost?! Uwaaaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh ho,
that was dangerous. Overwhelming pressure 
that could cause anyone nearby to wither,
while also having the ability to see the
invisible. What an intriguing girl.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, hey now Pocke.
You're trying to become the 
strongest, right? To do that,
you've got to be 
able to befriend any and everyone.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're right! If I try my best,
I can even befriend 
a gho— your friend! I'll be relying on you,
Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Haa…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Great! Since you've all been so great,
I'll be 
treating you today.
Order whatever you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Once we've finished, let's walk 
home together. Back to Tracen Academy!
